description: Makes the landscape snapshot timestamp unparseable so DirectoryFreshness drops its membership sentence: formatDate() takes its Number.isNaN guard in src/components/shared/formatDate.js, DirectoryFreshness's '!landscapeDate && !architecturesDate && !awardsDate' check evaluates its remaining operands instead of short-circuiting on a truthy landscape date, and its '(landscapeDate || architecturesDate)' separator before the awards sentence falls through to architecturesDate. Both expressions are in src/components/MemberDirectory/DirectoryFreshness.js. The field is read by that one component, so clearing it in the ordinary coverage build would swap which arm the note renders rather than add a case; the variant build renders the degraded note beside the real one.
